window_count.description: The IP's sliding-window count when the aggregator made this transition (spec section 5). Required on both event types. The trie stores a HotIpAdded's value as the IP's request_count (docs/protocol/read-api-v1.md, GET /ip/{addr}; ADR-0015 Amendment 5).

attributes.description: Optional descriptive per-IP attributes (spec section 46, ADR-0005). Absent is equivalent to {"attributes_version": 1}. Purely additive: the event `type` enum, the binary HOT/COLD semantics, and every field above are unchanged, and a consumer that ignores this key still derives exactly the same trie state.
